study type: Retrospective model development and validation study
outcome: Severity of BPD (no, mild, moderate, severe)
cohort: The study included 122 premature infants born at <= 28 weeks gestation and < 1250 g, with a mean birth weight of 990 g (range: 840-1120 g), admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit between 2020 and 2021.
finding: An artificial intelligence model developed using DenseNet121 architecture successfully identified and classified the severity of bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) on chest radiographs of premature infants, showing improving accuracy with radiographs taken at later postnatal weeks (up to 0.97 AUC for no BPD at week 4).
